name: Your Turn To Thrive
source:
Your Turn To Thrive is a visual novel and stage play sequel to Your Turn To Die, taking place 6 months after [spoiler]the massacre ending[/spoiler], with Nao Egokoro as the protagonist. She and Sara Chidouin start over in a fresh environment as they continue to recover from the events of the death game, forming new bonds of mutual support and unraveling the mystery of their new home. The story is focused on mental health, post-traumatic growth, and overcoming oppressive systems.

[From [url=https://yourturntothrive.itch.io/yttt]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《轮到你了》是一部视觉小说和舞台剧续集《轮到你死了》，故事发生在6个月后[spoiler]大屠杀的结局[/spoiler]，以江吾奈央为主角。她和莎拉·奇杜因在一个全新的环境中重新开始，继续从死亡游戏的事件中恢复过来，形成了新的相互支持的纽带，并揭开了新家的谜团。这个故事的重点是心理健康、创伤后成长和克服压迫系统。

[来自[url=https://yourturntothrive.itch.io/yttt]痒痒io[/url]]
